target_customer: Independent doctors and specialty practices that miss or under-handle patient phone calls
problem: Practices lose patients because calls go unanswered or are handled poorly by overstretched front desks and call centers.
business_model: B2B SaaS for AI voice agents (pricing not found)
product_category: Healthcare voice AI and patient scheduling

founders.name: Betty Chang
founders.background_notes: YC page: first business hire and later Chief of Staff at Capable Health; managed 100+ specialty clinics. Education not listed.

founders.name: Christopher Chen
founders.background_notes: YC page: 8th employee and founding engineer at Vanta; tech lead at Medallion. Education not listed.

competitors.name: Zocdoc
competitors.what: Patient booking marketplace that added AI voice agents in partnership with Cedar

technical_complexity.rationale: Voice agents integrated with practice scheduling systems and HIPAA constraints are standard but integration heavy for a two person team.

defensibility.rationale: Many voice AI entrants share the same model providers; moat would come from EHR integrations and practice relationships.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Zocdoc announced AI voice agents in May 2025, after the batch started.

market_need_then: Practices and call centers faced missed calls and staffing costs; voice AI for healthcare drew several funded startups in 2025.

branding.domain_note: Uses trapezehealth.com with a Health suffix, not the exact name .com; acquisition history not found.

identity.visual_style: Landing page fetched showed only a title and tagline
identity.voice_and_tone: Simple and approachable: the easiest way to grow your practice

branding.community_and_virality: Founders mention TikTok behind the scenes content on the YC page; no independent press on the brand found.

brand_strength.rationale: Little visible brand beyond the YC listing and a thin site; name is a common word shared with other companies.

outcome_analysis: Trapeze joined YC in Spring 2025 as a two person team with voice agents for doctors, claiming 140 plus practices onboarded. No exit, shutdown or layoffs were found. Funding is only visible in aggregators, so the stage of the company is early and its outcome is open, with a crowded healthcare voice AI field and larger incumbents entering during 2025.
notes: Funding unverified: VCBacked lists a pre-seed from June 2025 with YC and no amount; Employbl lists $500K sourced from Diffbot. No press release found. Traction of 140 plus doctors is a company claim. The YC page says hundreds of doctors in the launch post, so figures differ.
